name: qwen-engine-library
includes: primitive OpenAI-compatible toy causal LM server

primitive_toy_causal_lm.purpose: Back-to-basics transport and behavior lab before a real model exists
primitive_toy_causal_lm.model_location_policy: No model files required; uses a tiny built-in character n-gram corpus.

openai_compatible_api.purpose: Production-style Human Codex provider adapter target
openai_compatible_api.secret_handling: Read API key from environment only; never write it to logs or files.

local_transformers_probe.purpose: Research/debug mode for hidden states, logits, and lightweight activation inspection
local_transformers_probe.model_location_policy: Local path only by default; no automatic model download.

llama_cpp_gguf.purpose: Fast local GGUF serving path for small Qwen experiments
llama_cpp_gguf.model_location_policy: MODEL_GGUF must point to an already-downloaded local file.
